instructions.title: Mock Examination Instructions
instructions.rule1: You have 90 minutes to answer 50 questions distributed across all official exam domains.
instructions.rule2: You can flag questions for review and return to them anytime before time expires.
instructions.rule3: Once the exam is submitted, a detailed analysis report highlighting strengths and gaps is generated.
